text:
alex chen: Heads-up — deal with LumoTech: procurement insists on AWS Partner Private Offer, but their CFO wants a monthly consolidated invoice. We're blocked on billing path, looking for options.

maria gomez: They said PO-only. AWS Marketplace charges at purchase, so net-30 invoices don't come through by default. :thinking:

jonas li: If we do a Private Offer we can opt into direct invoicing, but that requires marketplace seller setup, legal sign-off, and ~2-3 weeks to enable. Discounts via PO need Deal Desk approval.

sam-deals: @jonas li correct. Option: offer a short-term commit for the POC (3-6 months) in exchange for a one-time discount. Need Deal Desk + Finance ok for any >10% concession.

procurement-bot: Procurement checklist (quick): company legal name, PO number, billing contact, remit to: "Redwood Inference Inc" — EIN 12-3456789, billing address, and SOW if POC transitions to paid. Attachments accepted as PDF.

maria gomez: LumoTech also requires VAT line items and account-level SKU mapping on invoices. Marketplace invoices are aggregated; they won't accept aggregated line items. Finance-ops, can we provide per-customer line items for Marketplace sales?

finance-ops: Marketplace settlements come as aggregated AWS reports. We can carve out a Private Offer configured for direct invoicing to the end-customer, but that requires AWS settings + finance/legal sign-off. Delegated approval: I can greenlight up to 10% discount; >10% needs VP Finance review.

alex chen: Deal question — is 15% okay if we get a 6mo minimum commit? Customer prefers monthly billing but will sign a commit if invoicing aligns. Also need credit hold check.

sam-deals: I'll open a Deal Desk ticket. Quick checklist I'm submitting: 1) SKU mapping table; 2) proposed commit tiers and discount bands; 3) POC-to-paid conversion clause; 4) requested billing flow (Private Offer direct invoice).

sam-deals: Pasting proposed SKU mapping snippet for LumoTech:
```
sku_map:
  customer_alias: LUMO-POC
  redwood_sku: SI-DED-16GPU-30d
  pricelist_id: PL-2025-07
  proposed_term: 6 months
  proposed_discount: 15%
```

jonas li: Also flag technical pre-reqs: they want SSO/SCIM and SOC2 before Prod. We can provide SOC2 report but it might delay the private offer timeline. Ops: can we fast-track SOC2 evidence to procurement?

maria gomez: We can share SOC2 report and a SOC2 attestation doc. For marketplace onboarding, some customers accept self-attestation initially with SOC2 within 30 days — depends on procurement flexibility.

finance-ops: I'll prep the finance justification for 15% to route to VP. If VP pushes back, we can propose 12% + a reference clause. Also need to confirm revenue recognition for Marketplace vs Direct invoice.

alex chen: Plan I'll propose to LumoTech: 1) Enable Private Offer so billing routes correctly; 2) sign a 6mo POC commit at 12-15% off; 3) we supply SOC2 within 30 days and SCIM within onboarding. @sam-deals please attach Deal Desk ticket ID to the PO.

sam-deals: Filed ticket DL-9876 with initial attachments. ETA for Deal Desk response: ~48 hours. :thumbsup:

maria gomez: Dropping LumoTech PO template here: https://redwood.internal/drive/lumotech-po-template — procurement will expect those fields filled.

jonas li: If anyone wants the marketplace flow diagram (how Private Offer -> invoicing maps), ping me and I'll paste it.

alex chen: Thanks everyone. I'll coordinate with LumoTech procurement this afternoon and update the thread after the call.

finance-ops: Marking follow-up: if VP approves >10% we need exec sponsor signoff before countersign.
